claim: coop-anything (MIT) defines a 9-phase workflow for adding co-op to single-player games: triage, research, workspace, understand (RE), choose, build, QA, ship, give back.
evidence: AGENTS.md 'Phase map' table lists phases 0-8 plus 3b (console) and 6b (split screen); two entry paths: revive an existing mod or build from zero.
verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: Describes the repo's process, not evidence that it produces working co-op for any given engine.
next_experiment: Map Project Mordor's phase plan onto phases 0-4 (triage through choose) and record which ones Phase 1 can complete without game integration.
